falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern failed to hold support; a 7%+ drawdown from typical August 2024 lows invalidates the structural bottom thesis and suggests the pattern match was coincidental, not predictive

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 39 implied controlled volatility; sustained panic-level VIX contradicts the 'HOLD' signal's embedded assumption that stress is contained and not accelerating into a regime change

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within any 3-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A flight-to-safety bid of this magnitude signals recession/deleveraging panic rather than the soft-landing bottom pattern; the macro engine's 'UNKNOWN' verdict assumed no imminent systemic credit event
